stories.headline: COP31 ends with no deal
stories.summary: The climate summit closes after a record two days of overtime. The EU and about 130 countries reject the final text — it has no fossil-fuel phase-out.

stories.headline: Strikes kill 11 near Kyiv
stories.summary: A drone attack wrecks part of a five-storey block in Dymer. A child is pulled out alive.

stories.headline: Trump: inclined to resume conflict
stories.summary: Trump may restart the conflict if no deal by New Year; Iran seeks a workable approach.

stories.headline: Democrats take the House
stories.summary: A historic majority of at least 258 seats — the largest since 1992.

stories.headline: Candy factory fire: 3 dead
stories.summary: At least 3 dead, 34–37 missing after a fire at the Milkita sweets factory in Serang.

stories.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury
stories.summary: The probe enters orbit around Mercury after an eight-year journey.
